item.title: “The path to nowhere”: Ministry of Defence accused of “pettiness” for blocking completion of new cycling and walking route to school – and threatening to fence off 15-metre section if children use it in “nonsensical” row
item.description: The government department claims the shared-use path could have a “detrimental impact” on local families, though the MOD’s decision to reopen discussions with Fife Council has been hailed as a “return to commonsense”

item.title: "This green initiative ensures that I now drive around to avoid it": Revamped roundabout leaves residents baffled by a segregated bike lane; Movistar man plays the bicycle; Brennan signs Visma contract extension + more on the live blog
item.description: It's Friday and Callum has decided there are better things to be doing than spending his wage and queuing for World Cup tickets, so he's here instead...

item.title: Universal Colours Unisex Spectrum Gilet 2.0
item.description: Good quality gilet that does exactly what's needed for rides on milder days when just a little extra protection is needed 7/10

item.title: “So, you don’t respect the Highway Code?” 10 Groupama-FDJ pro cyclists fined €100 for ‘riding through red light’ during Spanish training camp, according to reports
item.description: “€100 a head, he really enjoyed himself,” Ewen Costiou, one of the riders caught allegedly jumping the red light, wrote on Strava

item.title: From the party that brought you ‘cycle lanes are a waste of money’: Reform UK council hails “excellent” new bike path, celebrating “safer and greener environment for everyone”
item.description: “The area is helping to foster healthier lifestyle choices in more accessible pathways for walking and cycling,” a Reform planning chief said after the new cycle lane was opened – despite some residents complaining about traffic disruption

item.title: Join us at the inaugural Gravel and Adventure Bike Expo as part of the Adventure Travel Show in London!
item.description: London's Adventure Travel Show brings a Gravel and Adventure Bike Expo for the first time, and we'll be there!

item.title: Electric pumps have taken the cycling world by storm... but I'm not convinced
item.description: Arguably 2025's biggest bike tech trend, electric pumps take the effort out of tyre inflation. That's all well and good, but I still reckon regular pumps are better

item.title: Segway is making a new e-bike: teaser of mysterious Myon shows rear hub motor and RearView Radar technology
item.description: He’s behind you! The advanced RearView Radar should give a fuller picture of incoming traffic on Segway's latest two-wheeled project

item.title: Trek recalls 700 electric road and gravel bikes due to loose chainrings, as brand tells customers to stop riding immediately
item.description: The American company says the chainring bolts were “not tightened to specification during assembly”, causing them to loosen and potentially fall off the bike, creating a crash risk

item.title: Making an affordable race bike for 2026 is harder than you think — but there are some smart ways you can save with compromising performance
item.description: Liam tries to build a go-faster road bike for group rides and the occasional race
